capabilities: browse notes in a sidebar calendar by day, week, month, or custom date range
display daily and weekly notes on a timeline grouped by time slot
open notes from the timeline in the same or a new pane
indicate note density per day via tile background color
read actual creation dates from note metadata to fix Obsidian Sync timestamps
extras: Includes a section on working around Obsidian Sync's creation-timestamp issue by optionally reading creation dates from note metadata.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse notes by when they were created or edited on a calendar or timeline.
summary: Sidebar calendar plugin that shows a timeline of notes by creation and modification dates, with day, week, month and custom-range navigation.
